_help: The quest helper bar at the top right of the HUD (under the buff bar): the official bar of UI/Quest.img/Helper with the count of the quests. right = the right edge of the bar, top = the top edge. listRight = the right edge of the quest lines under the bar (they are right aligned), listTop = the top of the first line. closeDx/closeDy = the spot of the X button inside the bar, chevronDx = the spot of the chevron, chevronDownDy/chevronUpDy = the height of the chevron in its two states (the WZ puts them one pixel apart). numX1/numX2/numX3 = the spot of the count in the plate of the bar (the WZ gives one for one, two and three digits), numTop = the top of the count. The bar art (222x28), the buttons (11x11) and the count digits (6x5) are art sizes, they stay in the code.
